cleanRoom.source: Repo-owned Excel/MSForms fixture input generated through public Excel/VBIDE automation and driven with public Windows mouse and keyboard input.
cleanRoom.prohibited: No Office internals, decompilation, disassembly, non-public source, or OxForms output comparison.

notes: ToggleCheck fills the form client area so a single window-centre click focuses it; the capture then sends Space then Enter via public user32 SendInput.
Control fonts are intentionally not declared/applied (Click/Change/keyboard-toggle ordering oracle, not a text-metrics oracle).
ToggleCheck_KeyDown/KeyUp log the .Value at handler entry plus the KeyCode helper before/after, so value_at_keydown and value_at_keyup are observable relative to Click and Change.
